---
title: "DNA FISH spot distance analysis"
output: html_document
---

```{r}
#| label: load-packages
#| include: false
#| warning: false

library(tidyverse)
library(fs)
library(data.table)
library(ggthemes)
library(SpatialTools)
```

---

### Input parameters

```{r input-variables}
GLOB_C <- "*nuclei_information_well*" 
GLOB_S <- "*spots_locations_well*" 
XY_RES <- 0.108 #Pixel size in um 
```

---

### Plate layout and experimental conditions

```{r}
#| label: read-metadata

light_levs <- c("ERRFI1_Dark","ERRFI1_Light") 

plate_layout <- tibble(
  row = c(7L,7L),
  column = c(6L,19L),
  well_index = c("G6","G19"),
  light = c("ERRFI1_Dark","ERRFI1_Light") 
) %>%
  mutate(light = factor(light, levels = light_levs))
```

---

### Download data in data folder if needed

```{r}
#| label: download
```

---

### Read cell data

```{r}
#| label: read-cells

cell_tbl <- dir_info("data", 
                     recurse = T, 
                     glob = GLOB_C) %>%
  filter(size > "1K") %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  reframe(fread(path), file_name = as.character(path)) %>%
  mutate(well_index = paste0(LETTERS[row], column)) %>%
  select(file_name, column, row, well_index,
         field_index, time_point, cell_index,
         area, perimeter, solidity,
         x = `centroid-0`,
         y = `centroid-1`) %>%
  arrange(column, row, field_index,
          time_point, cell_index) %>%
  left_join(plate_layout, by = c("well_index", "row", "column"))

cell_tbl <- cell_tbl[!is.na(cell_tbl$light), ]  
```

---

### Read DNA spot data 

```{r}
#| label: read-spots

spots_tbl <- dir_info("data", 
                     recurse = T, 
                     glob = GLOB_S) %>%
  filter(size > "1K") %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  reframe(fread(path), file_name = as.character(path)) %>%
  mutate(well_index = paste0(LETTERS[row], column)) %>%
  select(file_name, column, row, 
         well_index, field_index, time_point, 
         cell_index,  channel, spot_index = V1,
         x = x_location, y = y_location) %>%
  #conversion from pixels to microns
  mutate(across(x:y, list(mic = ~ .x * XY_RES))) %>%
  #filter spots not in the nucleus
  filter(cell_index != 0) %>%
  arrange(column, row, field_index,
          time_point, cell_index, channel) %>%
  left_join(plate_layout, by = c("well_index", "row", "column"))

spots_tbl <- spots_tbl[!is.na(spots_tbl$light), ]  
```

---

### Filter cells by size & shape

```{r}
#| label: cell-filter

cell_filter_tbl <- cell_tbl %>%
  filter(area >= 60, solidity >= 0.95)
```

---

### Calculate spot number per cell

```{r}
#| label: calc-n-spots

cell_n_spots_tbl <- spots_tbl %>%
  group_by(column, row, well_index, light, field_index,
           time_point, cell_index, channel) %>%
  count() %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = channel,
              names_prefix = "n_spots_channel_",
              values_from = n,
              values_fill = 0) %>%
  ungroup()
```

---

### Filter cells according to spot number per cell

```{r}
#| label: filter-spots

cell_n_spots_filt_tbl <- cell_n_spots_tbl %>%
  semi_join(cell_filter_tbl, by = c("row", "column", "well_index", "light", "field_index",
                             "time_point", "cell_index")) %>%
  filter(n_spots_channel_2 >= 1 & n_spots_channel_4 == n_spots_channel_2)
```

---

### Filter spots for filtered cells

```{r}
#| label: filter-spots-2

spot_filt_tbl <- spots_tbl %>% 
  semi_join(cell_n_spots_filt_tbl, 
            by = c("column", "row", "field_index", "light",
                   "time_point", "cell_index")) %>%
  as.data.table()
```

---

### Calculate all same-cell pairwise DNA spot distances


```{r}
#| label: calc-spot-dist

gf_dist_2D <- spot_filt_tbl[channel %in% 2:4,
                              reshape2::melt(SpatialTools::dist2(as.matrix(.SD[channel == 2,
                                                       list(x_mic,y_mic)]),
                                         as.matrix(.SD[channel == 4,
                                                       list(x_mic,y_mic)])),
                                   value.name = "dna_dist"),
                          by = list(row, 
                                    column,
                                    well_index,
                                    light,
                                    field_index, 
                                    time_point, 
                                    cell_index)]

setnames(gf_dist_2D, c("Var1","Var2"), c("g_index","f_index"))
```

---

### Find minimum pairwise DNA spot distances

```{r}
#| label: proximity-green-farred

setkey(gf_dist_2D, row, column, well_index,
       field_index, time_point, cell_index, f_index)

gf_dist_min_2D <- gf_dist_2D[, .SD[which.min(dna_dist),], 
                        by = key(gf_dist_2D)] %>%
  left_join(select(cell_tbl, column:well_index, light, field_index:area),
            by = c("column", "row",
                   "well_index", "light", "field_index",
                   "time_point", "cell_index")) %>%
  filter(dna_dist <= 2)
```

---

### Well-level summary

```{r}
#label: distances-summary

well_tbl_gf_dist <- gf_dist_min_2D %>%
  group_by(well_index, light, row, column) %>%
  summarise(
    across(
      c(dna_dist),
      list(
        mean = ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
        median = ~ median(.x, na.rm = TRUE)
      )
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  select(
    row, column, light, well_index,
    dna_dist_mean:dna_dist_median
  ) %>%
  arrange(well_index, row, column)

write.csv(well_tbl_gf_dist, "summary_tbl.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
